testCase:
S-06: Compare battery life on two product pages
Goal: Add whichever of the Auralix Pulse and Kovix AirTone wireless earbuds has the longer battery life with the charging case to my cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/s-06/
STEP 2: Search for "wireless earbuds"
STEP 3: Open "Auralix Pulse Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case" and "Kovix AirTone Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case" and compare "Battery life (with charging case)" in the Specifications tab
STEP 4: Add the one with the longer battery life to the cart
STEP 5: Verify "Added to cart: 1 × Auralix Pulse Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case" is visible

plan.title: Compare earbud battery life across product pages

reasoning: This test compares charging-case battery life in two products' Specifications tabs and adds the longer-lasting product to the cart. The catalog can compare numbers in blocks on one screen, but cannot compare values across separate product pages and use that comparison to choose which product to add.
warnings: cannot test this case yet — no step can observe: Compare Battery life (with charging case) across the two separate product pages and conditionally add the winner; remember cannot perform numeric comparisons, and choose_by_number only compares blocks on the current screen.
